Defining mandibulofacial skeletal dysplasia, eyelid malformation/ectropion and macrostomia affect bone, eye and mouth. Ear abnormalities lack frequencies.

Congenital absence of a skeletal neck muscle; no additional organ involvement specified.
Inherited cardiac repolarization disorder with prolonged QT and ventricular arrhythmias; seizures are uncommon and may reflect arrhythmic syncope.

Inherited ABCA1-related HDL metabolism disorder; coronary atherosclerosis, even reported in 2/4, is a separately diagnosed disease rather than intrinsic organ involvement.

Skeletal dysplasia, deafness and intellectual disability define the syndrome; persistent hypopigmented skin lesions occur in 80-99%. Ptosis and delayed puberty omitted by cap.

Congenital malformation of the anus and rectum; urinary fistulas occur in particular subtypes and do not define the entire umbrella.
AMT glycine-cleavage deficiency causes hyperglycinemia and encephalopathy. Respiratory failure in 14/14 reflects central respiratory dysfunction, not intrinsic lung damage.
Prostate epithelial carcinoma lies outside the axes; lymphocytic infiltrates do not make this a lymphoma or autoimmune disease.

HSV-1 infection umbrella without a specified anatomical site; keratitis and encephalitis are distinct minority manifestations, and mucocutaneous sites vary.
Necrotizing giant-cell vasculitis directly inflames small vessels; no specific visceral organ has established common involvement in the supplied evidence.
Mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation disorder; hypertrophic cardiomyopathy in 5/5 and developmental delay in 3/5. Hearing loss in 1/5 is below threshold.
Nonsyndromic inherited sensorineural hearing loss; no extra-auditory disease is defined.
Syndesmodysplasic dwarfism denotes a hereditary skeletal/connective-tissue dysplasia; supplied evidence does not establish another affected axis.
PROM1-related inherited retinal degeneration; retinal disease belongs to the ocular axis despite the hereditary neurological ancestor.
ARSL enzyme deficiency causes skeletal dysplasia; mixed hearing impairment occurs in 30-79%. Airway disease, cord compression and developmental delay are under 30%.
